# request

### request.security() {#request-security}

```ts
request.security(resolution: Resolution, fn: (ctx: SecurityContext) => Series, options?: { confirmed?: boolean }): Series
```

A value from a higher resolution (TradingView request.security), e.g. the daily EMA on a 1h chart: `request.security("1D", (h) => h.ta.ema(h.candle.close, 20))`. The result is bar-aligned with the chart and follows the forming higher-timeframe bar; `{ confirmed: true }` returns the last completed bar's value instead.

Types: [Resolution](./types#resolution), [SecurityContext](#securitycontext), [Series](./series#series)

## Types

### SecurityContext {#securitycontext}

The higher-timeframe context passed to `request.security`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `candle` | `{ readonly open: Series; readonly high: Series; readonly low: Series; readonly close: Series; readonly volume: Series; readonly turnover: Series; readonly time: Series }` | Candles of the requested resolution, built from the chart's bars; the last one is still forming. (read-only) |
| `ta` | `typeof ta` | The same ta functions, advancing once per higher-timeframe bar. (read-only) |
